audio_description:
Rows of glowing pink containment cubes fill a vast Esthar chamber.
They stretch toward seated figures at the rim.
The tall Esthar sealing monolith lowers onto a barren plain at sunset.

context.scene_title: The Esthar sealing apparatus — a containment chamber and the tall Esthar sealing monolith descending onto the plain (Sorceress Memorial / Adel's tomb), Disc 3.
locations: A futuristic Esthar amphitheater/chamber lined with grids of glowing pink containment pods (figures seated at the rear), and the open plain at sunset where the tall Esthar monolith-container settles down

characters.name: (seated figures, indistinct)
characters.recognition: Rows of seated forms ring the chamber behind the pod-grid; too distant/dim to identify.

context.summary: Inside a vast Esthar chamber, endless rows of glowing pink containment cubes stretch toward seated figures at the rim. The view then shows the tall Esthar sealing monolith, marked with the Esthar emblem, lowering onto a barren plain beneath a sunset sky — the sorceress-sealing structure being set in place.
context.context_note: Read as the Esthar Sorceress Memorial / Adel's-tomb sealing apparatus (Disc 3); identity inferred from the Esthar container and sealing-pod imagery.
